data.title: bn-1hh: Build RIBBIT RECOIL with cmusic bundle
data.description: Review the native game.cmusic bundle, extracted build project, gameplay SFX/music remapping, generated source provenance, and console build/play/runtime verification.

data.body: LOW: README generation joins lines with `"\\n"`, producing literal backslash-n characters instead of line breaks. The checked-in README is therefore one 470-byte line and renders as escaped text. Use `.join("\n")` and regenerate it.

MEDIUM: The documented  verification is not reproducible from a clean checkout. The required build/ribbit-recoil.cart is ignored and untracked, so a freshly regenerated project exits 1 with ; it reports current here only because this workspace retains an ignored artifact from the author's prior build. Either commit the canonical generated cart and keep , or change the clean-checkout instructions/verification to create an explicit temporary output (and reserve  for a second pass after creation).

Clarification: the documented command console build carts/ribbit-recoil-project --check is not reproducible from a clean checkout. build/ribbit-recoil.cart is ignored and untracked, so a freshly regenerated project exits 1 with the message that the output does not exist and must first be created. It reports current in this workspace only because an ignored artifact remains from the author build. Either commit the canonical generated cart and keep the check command, or document a normal build to an explicit temporary output and reserve --check for a second pass after creation.

Addressed: README and docs now show the normal build first, followed by --check as a second pass. The generated build output remains intentionally ignored because project sources and audio bundle are authoritative.
Addressed: generator now joins README lines with real newlines and regeneration produced a normal Markdown file.
